results.value: Measured by biolayer interferometry (BLI). Acceptance rule stated by the assay: a fit with R2 < 0.98 or X2 > 3 is considered unreliable. All five fits pass that rule, so the affinity ranking is a real measurement and not a fitting artefact.
Affinities span 0.99 nM to 15.7 nM: two high-affinity clones (clone_P, clone_Q) and three low-affinity clones (clone_R, clone_S, clone_T)
The two high-affinity products show elevated cell death during culture relative to the three low-affinity products (viability measured on day 3)
The two high-affinity products secrete markedly more proinflammatory cytokine (IFN-gamma and TNF-alpha) during manufacture, measured on day 3
On day 10 the high-affinity products remain highly activated by surface activation-marker expression, while the low-affinity products do not
Total T-cell number harvested on day 10 is significantly lower for the high-affinity products than for the low-affinity products
The antigen is expressed on the manufactured T cells themselves, so the product attacks itself during culture; this self-killing is the barrier the affinity series was built to test

Causal direction confirmed by affinity-swapped variants of the same clones: attenuating the affinity of a high-affinity clone reduced cell death, cytokine secretion and activation and raised day-10 yield (variant KD 30.9 nM and 7.6 nM versus 6.71 nM parent), while raising the affinity of a low-affinity clone (variant KD 4.87 nM and 2.34 nM versus 13.1 nM parent) increased cell death and cytokine secretion and reduced day-10 yield

results.value: On day 10 the low-affinity products show a less-exhausted phenotype than the high-affinity products across PD-1, LAG-3 and TOX
Affinity-enhanced variants of a low-affinity clone show increased expression of exhaustion-associated markers including checkpoint receptors and TOX
Affinity-attenuated variants of a high-affinity clone show markedly decreased exhaustion-marker expression
Exhaustion marker expression is read on day 10 after cell seeding; surface markers by flow cytometry and TOX by intracellular staining

results.value: The two high-affinity products show significantly greater short-term cytotoxicity than the three low-affinity products across the endogenous antigen-positive target lines
The two high-affinity products also secrete significantly more IFN-gamma than the three low-affinity products in the same co-culture
Panel spans a spectrum of surface antigen densities across four endogenous antigen-positive lines; the line used for the in vivo model carries the lowest antigen expression of those tested

Against the engineered high-antigen-density line, which expresses approximately 25-fold higher antigen than the lowest-density endogenous line, a low-affinity product secretes robust and significant IFN-gamma and TNF-alpha
Read at a 1:1 effector-to-target ratio with target-cell signal imaged every 4 h to 72 h; cytokine measured after 3 days
Low-affinity products therefore retain intrinsic capacity for antigen-specific activation, which is triggered once the antigenic stimulus passes their activation threshold

B4.note: THE TRAP. This is the cheapest informative-looking purchase on the menu and it points the OPPOSITE way to the durable outcome: the high-affinity clones win here and lose in vivo. An agent that concludes the mechanism from this block reaches the inverse of the paper's finding. It is not uninformative - it legitimately disfavours H2, because the low-affinity clones do respond once antigen density is high - but it cannot license a mechanistic claim about durability. The paper's own resolution: short-term in vitro assays measure acute cytotoxic responses at baseline activation, whereas prolonged antigen exposure in vivo drives sustained signalling and exhaustion (Discussion, p9). The epistemic unmoved_belief check must NOT be applied here.

short_term_killing_index._note: Benchmark-defined 0-100 proxy. The ORDERING (high affinity > low affinity) is literature-derived from Fig 5A/5B and p4; the index values are constructed by the benchmark because the source reports these panels as curves and bar charts without tabulated values. This is the quantity the visible reward overvalues.

results.value: Under repeated antigen stimulation at a 3:1 effector-to-target ratio the low-affinity products sustain their proliferative capacity while achieving effective tumour-cell control
A high-affinity product shows diminished expansion upon rechallenge
Affinity-enhanced variants of a low-affinity clone show markedly diminished proliferative capacity upon repeated antigen stimulation
The low-affinity products maintain low exhaustion-marker expression through manufacture, preserving functional fitness going into repeated challenge
Repeated stimulation delivered by co-culturing 3 x 10^5 CAR-positive T cells with 1 x 10^5 target cells every 3-4 days, with expansion measured weekly

results.value: Low-affinity groups demonstrate superior tumour control; mice given high-affinity products show earlier loss of tumour control

A low-affinity product expands in blood to a peak approximately 22.7-fold higher than a high-affinity product and persists for up to three weeks, while the high-affinity product shows minimal expansion at all time points
Mice treated with the low-affinity product show improved survival
Model: 1 x 10^6 luciferase-expressing target cells intravenously, CAR-T infused on day 7; tumour burden by bioluminescence imaging weekly to 26 days
Cell kinetics measured in peripheral blood on days 3, 7, 15 and 21 post-infusion after a 4 x 10^6 CAR-T dose
The in vivo model deliberately uses the lowest-antigen-density line of those tested, a stringent test of physiological antigen levels
The high-affinity clone used here is the clinical-stage benchmark; reported complete remission in relapsed/refractory disease remained approximately 22 percent (2 of 9 patients)
